00.name: Sweat
00.text: Lost again. How is it possible to get lost twice.

lost_again_2.name: Sour
lost_again_2.text: I don't know why your complaining. This is suppost to be an adventure. You have to learn to go with the flow and enjoy yourself.

lost_again_3.name: Sweat
lost_again_3.text: I'm complaining because as we speak lord Pasta is sitting on his throne waiting for us to deliver the relic.

lost_again_4.name: Sour
lost_again_4.text: So what we'll just walk a bit faster to make up for the time lost.

lost_again_5.name: Sweat
lost_again_5.text: Sometimes I hate working with you.

lost_again_6.name: Narrator
lost_again_6.text: You continue to walk along the trail as the mountains of Penne come into sight.

02.name: Sweat
02.text: This is why we shoudn't follow Sour. Sour always gets lost.

04.name: Sweat
04.text: You once got lost in your own bedroom and couldn't find the door.

05.name: Sour
05.text: That was a long time ago. My sense of direction has gotten way better since then.

07.name: Sour
07.text: And like I said I've imrpoved since then.

10.name: Narrator
10.text: You continue to walk along the trail as the mountains of Penne come into sight.
